lines.en: My tail rides high as I go
My claws tap the dirt path
I cross a forest clearing
I run at an easy pace
My ears stay pointed ahead
I crunch a fallen leaf
I head toward a scent
I hop over a shallow hollow
I sit and scratch an ear
My tail sweeps the ground

lines.zh: 我等着听见自己的名字
lines.en: I wait to hear my name called
I press my nose to the ground and sniff.
I scratch the mud with a forepaw
I half-yawn
I sit and stand again
I hear something in the woods
I tip my head at a sound
I chew on a twig
I turn one ear aside
I chase my own tail
I raise my head to you
My nose nudges your hand
Both my ears point at you
Your hands carry no meat
I run a circle around you
I sit and wait for you
I give one short yelp
I put a paw on your foot
I rub up against your ankle
I put a paw on your leg
My tail wags busily
I tip my head at you
I lick your hand
I tuck my tail and dodge
That left me dazed
I whine quietly

lines.zh: 我的毛焦了一块，抖抖就好。
lines.en: A patch of my fur is singed; a shake fixes it.
A patch of my fur is mussed
My four legs still hold
I press close to your feet
Stop coming at me
Is that raw meat you hold
I smell it, it is fresh
I poke my nose at your hand
Hold the meat a little higher
I hop for your hand
This piece is very good
I circle you, nose working
I sit up and wait
You bumped into me
I roll half over and right myself
I am very light
You nearly stepped on me
I hop away and come back
My fur is all over you
The knock tips me sideways
I shake the ash off my back
My paws land on your shoe
I scurry back to your feet
There is another scent in these woods
I catch one's scent

lines.zh: 我们各自跟着自己的主人
lines.en: We each follow our own tamer

lines.zh: 我还没到想这个的年纪
lines.en: I am too young to think of it
My tamer has not given leave
I go on running ahead

lines.zh: 洛加兽的嚎叫，没人回应。
lines.en: Loogamon's howl draws no answer.
I dip my head
And I run off again
The woods are quiet but for me
I carry it over to you
This could break stone
I dig it out
I hold it under a paw

lines.zh: 这块矿石，我挖出来带回去。
lines.en: I dig out this ore and carry it back.
I wag my tail with it in my mouth
I roll it to your feet

lines.zh: 地上这颗数据碎片，我收下了。
lines.en: I'll keep this data fragment from the ground.
A scent is coming closer
I snap my head up alert
My ears are up straight
I run that way
The fur on my back rises
I dart in front of you
My fur rises toward it
Do not block my way
I crouch low, my throat growing hot.
I stay right beside you
My nose works along the ground
I am a little faster than you
My tail has not stopped
I bark once that way
Can you hear my claws
I have circled around there
I have run this stretch many times
My hind legs brace to pounce.
I bite your hand
I leap and cling on
I rake you with both paws
I butt your knee
I bite and wrench sideways
You kick me loose
That bite only caught skin
I pull back and circle in
I leap for your arm
I let go and spring back
A pair of ears pops out of the grass
I dart out from behind a tree
My nose comes out first
The leaves crackle under me
I shake the grass off
I sit and look at you
A small shadow joins the treeline
I run a circle before I stop
I raise my head to the wind
I put my paws on a stone
I poke my head out first
Dry leaves cover the ground under me
Fire singes a patch of my fur
I land in a tumble
The blast rolls me away
An arrow scrapes my flank
Magic makes my fur stand up
Hunger softens all four legs
The strike jolts me
I howl as I drop
